title: The Impossible Postcard
author: F. M. Brightwater
blurb: Bram Winterbourne, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, has spent three years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
